verdict: FAIL_SOURCE_ONLY_DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_RELEASE_OR_ATTEMPT. M1947 correctly binds the exact M1941/M1942 reviews, M1942 filelist/TB, M1934 sealed failure/attempt, frozen docs/359, and future M1949/M1950 identities. It also preserves clean-environment execution, scoped VCS_HOME, fresh namespace, same-UID collision exclusion, attempt-before-license ordering, one license query, one VCS compile, one simv run, no retry, no-replace double-sealed publication, and a unique PASS token. However, its post-simulation rejection pattern does not match the actual VCS concurrent-assertion failure text used by this installed V-2023.12-SP1 tool. A failed SVA can therefore coexist with the unique TB PASS token and be published as RAW_PASS. This is an admission-critical false-positive path. M1948 ran no license query, VCS, simv, DC, PT, or attempt.

findings.title: M1947 can publish RAW_PASS despite a concurrent SVA failure

evidence.installed_vcs_failure_format: <property hierarchical name>: started at <time> failed at <time>

findings.impact: A protocol, stability, numeric-overflow, or source-binding SVA can fail while the directed initial block reaches its unique PASS display. Because the current negative grep misses VCS's real failure wording, M1947 would seal and publish that run as a raw passing result. A later result hammer cannot repair the launch-chain guarantee unless it independently reimplements the missing check.
findings.required_fix: Do not edit M1947 in place. Author an additive fresh successor that makes assertion failure terminal, preferably with the supported VCS global assertion max-fail control, and also explicitly rejects the installed-tool signature `: started at .* failed at` (plus `Assertion.*failed`, `Error-[SVA`, `$error`, and `$fatal`) in simv.log. Preserve all otherwise-passing governance, bind this sealed M1948 failure, use fresh result/attempt/failure/work/lock namespaces, and obtain a new different-author runner review and release audit before any license query or VCS attempt.

required_next_gate: Create an additive fresh runner with terminal and text-level concurrent-SVA failure detection, exact M1948 failure binding, and otherwise unchanged M1947 governance. A new different-author source hammer and separate launch-release audit must pass before exactly one fresh VCS attempt.
